symbols.purpose: Shape of a plugin definition: name, configuration, Features, activation mode and lifecycle hooks.
symbols.core:
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Optional configuration: definePlugin snapshots and recursively freezes it at definition time; installation creates a registration-owned copy. Plain records/arrays and supported primitive or function leaves are admitted, while invalid values and cycles reject. Read core.config.get() or host.config.get(path); commit changes with host.config.update().
Omitted; the public definition.config is undefined and the host uses an empty configuration record.
features: Record of named roots created by defineFeature. Their dependency maps can reference provider.getFeature(name). The host installs required providers first and injects resolved root outputs as core.features.<name>.
Omitted; no Feature roots.
install: Required object-form hook. Receives the domain core plus config, operation, lifecycle, onDispose and pipeline registration methods; declared Feature outputs are ready. Return an extension record, or an awaitable record through asynchronous use(). Own enumerable data properties must be configurable; frozen extension records are rejected.
install.core: Registration-local capabilities. onDispose(resource) is allowed only during install: pass a void/PromiseLike<void> cleanup function or a disposable object; resources are released in reverse order after the plugin disposer.
install.setupOutput: Second argument only when setup is declared; exact resolved setup output. Otherwise install receives only core.
setup: Optional preparation hook before Feature construction and install. Receives config.get(), operation.signal/deadlineAt/now(), lifecycle.signal and onDispose(resource), but no Features or pipeline registration. Its exact resolved result becomes the second install/featureExpose argument.
Omitted; no preparation phase or second hook argument.
featureExpose: Optional object of methods or synchronous hook producing it. Feature factories receive only this explicit read-only method facade, not the whole install core; methods are revoked when the registration ends.
Omitted; an empty expose object.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Optional configuration: definePlugin snapshots and recursively freezes it at definition time; installation creates a registration-owned copy. Plain records/arrays and supported primitive or function leaves are admitted, while invalid values and cycles reject. Read core.config.get() or host.config.get(path); commit changes with host.config.update().
Omitted; the public definition.config is undefined and the host uses an empty configuration record.
features: Record of named roots created by defineFeature. Their dependency maps can reference provider.getFeature(name). The host installs required providers first and injects resolved root outputs as core.features.<name>.
Omitted; no Feature roots.
install: Required installation callback receiving the registration core and optional setup output. Its returned extension object is published only after the installation batch commits.
install.core: Host-provided hook core with lifecycle registration and resolved Feature outputs.
install.setupOutput: Value returned by setup when using the setup branch, otherwise absent.
Extension record or thenable of it; throw or rejection rolls back the installation batch.
setup: Optional setup-branch callback receiving `IPluginSetupContext`; its value or thenable supplies setup output to later hooks, and failure rolls back registration.
setup.context: Setup context supplied by the host, including the operation signal and provisional resource ownership.
Setup output, optionally asynchronous, retained for feature exposure and install.
featureExpose: Value or callback publishing this plugin’s Feature input surface. A callback receives the host core and optional setup output; return the exposure object synchronously.
featureExpose.core: Host-supplied lifecycle core for this registration.
featureExpose.setupOutput: Output returned by this plugin’s setup hook, absent for the plain hook branch.
Synchronous Feature exposure object used by dependent Features.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The core argument passed to a plugin during install(core) and update(next, core). It combines application services supplied by the host with that plugin's configuration, current-operation information, and methods for registering resources and processing functions. It does not expose use, unUse or dispose, so the plugin cannot manage the host through this argument. A plugin can register processing functions only inside its install callback. The host owns those registrations and removes them when that plugin is uninstalled. Registering later throws RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL, meaning that resource registration is outside the installation period.

symbols.purpose: Options of a host (`new PluginHost(options)` and `defineHost({ host })`).
symbols.core:
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false, with no default. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; no default. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Optional pipeline record. mode is sync, async, generator or async-generator; defaults to sync and is fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe diagnostic throwing or rejecting without changing host operations. Omission forwards failure to globalThis.reportError when available. Return no value from this final receiver.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

symbols.signature: export type IPluginRuntimeSharedSlot<TFacade extends object = object> = Readonly<{ /** One stable facade for this Host key/family, created by its canonical extension owner. */ readonly facade: TFacade; /** An absent target returns undefined; duplicated instance identity returns null. */ find(target: string): object | null | undefined; /** Snapshot of current ready contributions, separate from cold registration inventory. */ values(): readonly object[]; /** * Cold inventory reads every committed reservation, including registrations without ready * sessions. */ registered(): readonly object[]; /** Annotates this exact original reservation; metadata is published only with its install commit. */ register(value: object, onCommit?: () => void): void; /** Withdraw only this exact ready contribution; the live registration retains its shared slot. */ contribute(value: object, instanceId: string): () => void; }>;
symbols.purpose: One shared extension slot of a host, returned by `getPluginRuntimeIntegration(core).acquireSharedSlot(key, family, create)`. Several adapter plugins of the same family (for example several RPC transports) publish into one slot, and the host exposes one shared facade for all of them under `key`.
symbols.core:
facade: The shared facade built once by the `create` callback of the first plugin that acquired the slot; later plugins of the family receive the same object.
find: Finds one ready contribution. An instance id given to `contribute()` is matched first, then a registration (plugin) name.
find.target: An instance id passed to `contribute(value, instanceId)` by some plugin, or that plugin's name.
The contributed value; `undefined` when nothing matches or its plugin is not active (suspended, removed), `null` when several contributions share the target.
values: Lists the values of every current contribution of the slot, in contribution order.
A new read-only array; empty once the slot is retired.
registered: Lists the metadata objects that committed registrations passed to `register()`, including suspended or not yet ready plugins.
A new read-only array of metadata objects.
register: Attaches one metadata object to the current plugin's registration; it becomes visible through `registered()` only when the install commits, and disappears if the install rolls back.
register.value: Metadata object describing this plugin in the family.
register.onCommit: Optional; called once after the install committed.
Nothing; the metadata is published with the install commit.
contribute: Publishes one ready value under an instance id. During install it is staged and published only if the install commits; after commit it is published at once. Throws `REGISTRATION_REVOKED` once the slot is retired.
contribute.value: Object to publish.
contribute.instanceId: Non-empty id chosen by the contributing plugin (for example a connection or peer id it generated); consumers pass the same id to `find()`.
A withdraw function that removes only this contribution; calling it again does nothing.
symbols.advanced: Several transport plugins register their peers, and one facade on the host finds a peer by instance id.

A new host only manages plugins (install, remove, disable, replace, configure, dispose) and pipeline stages; every domain capability arrives through plugins. Subclasses provide the domain core plugins receive by overriding `createPluginDomainCore()`.
symbols.core:
options: Required IPluginHostOptions, including explicit mutation and pipeline-drain execution budgets; optional identity, pipeline and diagnostics configure this Host only.
A new empty PluginHost instance; install plugins to obtain domain capabilities and await dispose() when its lifetime ends. Invalid configuration throws before the instance is published.
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false, with no default. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; no default. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Optional pipeline record. mode is sync, async, generator or async-generator; defaults to sync and is fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe diagnostic throwing or rejecting without changing host operations. Omission forwards failure to globalThis.reportError when available. Return no value from this final receiver.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false, with no default. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; no default. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Required execution budgets: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Optional pipeline record. mode is sync, async, generator or async-generator; defaults to sync and is fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe diagnostic throwing or rejecting without changing host operations. Omission forwards failure to globalThis.reportError when available. Return no value from this final receiver.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
A library (logger, store, RPC peer) extends `PluginHost` so users add optional plugins instead of more constructor options.
An application composes cache, auth and telemetry as plugins that share capabilities through Features and are removed with full cleanup.
There are only one or two fixed extension points that never change at runtime: plain options or function composition are simpler.

guidance.heading: 创建 Host 与全部选项

blocks.text: 类入口可重写 `createPluginDomainCore()`，每次安装创建一份领域 core。默认返回空对象。领域 core 必须是普通对象、可枚举 data property，不能覆盖 `config`、`onDispose` 或四个 `use*Pipeline` core 保留成员；无效表面以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。
函数入口 `defineHost(options)` 返回冻结的 canonical handle。它提供与类入口相同的功能，并把类上的 protected `useSync`、`runPipeline` 暴露给持有 handle 的 owner。选项 `host` 必填，形状与类构造选项一致；其余字段如下：

rows: 可选；省略返回空对象。request 的 `pluginName`、从零开始的批内 `batchIndex`、`batch` 身份均由宿主提供
可选；省略保留原 PluginHostError；默认结构化结果路径不调用此钩子，也不逐项转换 cleanupErrors
可选；自定义释放中间件，回调自行调用 `next()` 纳入内核清理；重复内核释放仍复用原 Promise
可选；默认无领域公开成员，第四类型参数默认空表面

blocks.text: surface 的自有描述符在获取 Runtime 之前读取一次，访问器保持动态；领域方法、Host 身份、共享出口和 fluent 管线方法属于同一个冻结 handle。canonical Host 键（包括 identity）保留且优先。组合方应在这里提供自己的方法，不能复制返回的冻结 handle。surface 选项或描述符读取失败保持原错，经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界分类。旧三类型参数调用仍有效。
类构造 `options` 必填，defineHost 的 `host` 同样必填：

rows: 可读名称可选，宿主另分配唯一 id
本次变更 hook 的执行预算；`false` 无期限
pipeline 租约排空预算；`false` 等真实排空
接收诊断及被包含的原始失败对象
诊断器自身 throw/reject 的终端出口
默认只诊断；数值表示排队拒绝阈值；false 关闭相关计时与诊断
仅未配置排队拒绝阈值时生效；false 关闭诊断计时器
单个普通释放步骤的等待预算；false 无期限

blocks.text: 所有时间数值须有限、非负；非法选项、非函数回调或不满足 scheduler 协议的对象以 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。直接导入 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的消费项目需直接安装 utils。

PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `@migaia/plugin-host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

rows: 宿主已终态，创建新 Host，不能复用。
宿主正在关闭，不能开始新变更。
同一名称已占用或在批次中重复。
目标名称不存在，或句柄已无对应安装。
插件禁用中，先恢复再调用。
必需 provider 不可用使插件挂起，先恢复依赖。
lazy 插件未激活，先 await activate。
请求了未声明的 Feature 名称。
必需 provider 从未安装，安装前直接拒绝。
必需 provider 已禁用，启用后重试。
必需 provider 已卸载，需要重新安装。
Feature 跨插件引用成环，任何 install 前拒绝。
变更会遗留必需依赖者，detail.blockedBy 列出传递闭包。
替换候选名称不同，未安装候选。
新 provider 已提交但依赖者重装失败，cause.errors 首项为重装失败。
退役或不支持的定义字段、非法依赖或非 canonical core，保留 TypeError。
安装/发布失败，原错在 cause，回滚详情保留次错。
即时 useSync 安装遇到 setup，改用异步 use。
仅诊断：回滚也失败，不替换原安装主错。
install 结果自带 then，或同步路径得到异步结果，不发布此扩展。
beforeRelease 或插件释放步骤失败，cause 保留原错，其余清理继续。
扩展键已占用，Host 保留键优先分类为 EXTENSION_RESERVED。
扩展使用 Host 协议键、then 或清理 symbol。
仅诊断：有意忽略非枚举扩展键。
core 在安装窗口外拒绝且不接管；setup 关闭后的有效资源先释放再拒绝。
生命周期同步重入，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期发起变更，不能执行。
构造时 mode 非四种合法值。
stage 无法提升到 Host 模式，cause 保留上游 TypeError。
同次 stage 重复调用 next，不重复派发。
仅诊断：stage 已结束后调用 next，忽略此调用。
管线执行期间注册新 stage。
async 双失败，AggregateError.errors 固定为 stage、downstream。
已配置准入期限且排队到限，任务移出并不再执行。
beforeRelease 或普通释放步骤超预算，结束等待并继续清理，不强行取消。
入参形状不合法，保留原生 TypeError，修正输入。
配置不满足普通数据语法，detail 含 path/reason。
配置含引用环，提供无环值图。
未分类配置、surface 读取或 defineHost disposal 回调失败；保留原错或 cause。
hook 执行到限，丧失提交权限，迟到结果不能提交。
已取出的扩展属于已卸载或替换的旧注册。
普通卸载排空超预算，ok false，继续有界清理并诊断。
逻辑关闭已提交，清理有错或仍未完成；读取结果与 continuation。
组合目标非本物理包登记的 Host，不做结构兼容。

sections.content: Kinds of cleanup error nodes reported by `readPluginHostDisposalProvenance()`: `host-error` (an error created by the host), `aggregate` (several failures combined) and `disposer-wrapper` (a wrapper around a failing disposer).

blocks.text: PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `@migaia/plugin-host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

symbols.core:
code: Stable IPluginHostErrorCode selected from PluginHostErrorCode for the actual Host failure.
message: Caller-authored concrete diagnostic text passed to the native Error constructor.
A PluginHostError carrying the package source, selected code, original cause and optional detail. Construction returns the error without throwing it.
source: Always `@migaia/plugin-host`.
code: A `PluginHostErrorCode` value; branch on it.
detail: Structured data for some codes, e.g. `failedName`, `blockedBy`, `dependents`.

Omit cause when there is no earlier failure. No original failure is then attached through cause.
detail: Structured diagnostics supplied by the error creator, retained separately from the original `cause`.
Not set: no structured detail is attached.

guidance.heading: 创建 Host 与全部选项

blocks.text: 类入口可重写 `createPluginDomainCore()`，每次安装创建一份领域 core。默认返回空对象。领域 core 必须是普通对象、可枚举 data property，不能覆盖 `config`、`onDispose` 或四个 `use*Pipeline` core 保留成员；无效表面以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。
函数入口 `defineHost(options)` 返回冻结的 canonical handle。它提供与类入口相同的功能，并把类上的 protected `useSync`、`runPipeline` 暴露给持有 handle 的 owner。选项 `host` 必填，形状与类构造选项一致；其余字段如下：

rows: 可选；省略返回空对象。request 的 `pluginName`、从零开始的批内 `batchIndex`、`batch` 身份均由宿主提供

可选；默认无领域公开成员，第四类型参数默认空表面

symbols.signature: export declare const PluginHostErrorCode: { /** * Thrown when a mutation or registration targets a host after disposal completes. * * The terminal state is irreversible. Create a new host instead of reviving this one. Enforces * the terminal boundary of the two-phase lifecycle contract. */ readonly hostDisposed: 'HOST_DISPOSED'; /** * Thrown when a mutation targets a closing host after `dispose()` starts but before the terminal * state. * * This differs from `HOST_DISPOSED` so diagnostics distinguish disposal in progress from * completed disposal. Retrying later cannot reopen either host. */ readonly hostDisposing: 'HOST_DISPOSING'; /** * Thrown when installing a plugin whose `name` is already occupied. * * Plugin names are unique host keys. Rename the plugin or `unUse()` the previous plugin first. */ readonly pluginDuplicate: 'PLUGIN_DUPLICATE'; /** * Thrown when `unUse()` or another operation targets an uninstalled plugin name. * * Check for repeated removal or a misspelled name. Host state stays unchanged. Prepared removals * also reject this code when their exact generation is no longer current; no cleanup may repeat * and a replacement registration stays live. */ readonly pluginNotInstalled: 'PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED'; /** * A handle member, or an extension taken from it, is used while that plugin is disabled; also * thrown by `activate()` on a disabled lazy plugin. Enforces per-registration liveness; the * caller should `enable` the plugin (or its restore token) before retrying. */ readonly pluginDisabled: 'PLUGIN_DISABLED'; /** * A dependent plugin is temporarily suspended because one of its required providers is inactive. * The caller must restore or reinstall the provider and wait for automatic resume before * retrying. Enforces the suspend dependency policy without treating the registration as removed. */ readonly pluginSuspended: 'PLUGIN_SUSPENDED'; /** * A lazy plugin is accessed synchronously before activation, or a synchronous install needs an * inactive lazy provider. Activation is an explicit async step; the caller should `await * host.activate(name)` or install through the async `use()` path. */ readonly pluginNotActivated: 'PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED'; /** * `definition.getFeature(name)` or `handle.getFeature(name)` named a Feature the plugin does not * declare. Lookups never return `undefined`; the caller has a wrong name or wrong plugin. */ readonly featureNotDeclared: 'FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED'; /** * A required Feature provider was never installed in this host (a removed one reports * `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`). symbols.purpose: The 45 Host error and diagnostic codes. Host protocol and configuration-domain failures use PluginHostError; input/definition validation preserves native TypeError. CALLBACK_FAILED classifies otherwise unowned callback or surface-descriptor failures while preserving writable native identity, immutable/non-Error cause and existing foreign ownership. Diagnostic-only codes reach diagnostic instead of being thrown.
symbols.core:
hostDisposed: `HOST_DISPOSED`: the host finished disposal; create a new host.
hostDisposing: `HOST_DISPOSING`: disposal started; no new change can start.
pluginDuplicate: `PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`: the plugin is installed, or a batch repeats a name.
pluginNotInstalled: `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`: no plugin of that name (`unUse`, `config.update`, handle access).
pluginDisabled: `PLUGIN_DISABLED`: the plugin is disabled; enable it first.
pluginSuspended: `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`: suspended because a required provider is unavailable.
pluginNotActivated: `PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`: a lazy plugin was used before `activate()`.
featureNotDeclared: `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`: `getFeature(name)` asked for an undeclared Feature.
prerequisiteMissing: `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`: a required provider was never installed.
dependencyCycle: `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`: Feature references form a cycle; nothing was installed.
dependencyBlocked: `DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`: required dependents block removal or disabling; see `detail.blockedBy`.
replaceNameMismatch: `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`: `replace(name, next)` got a different plugin name.
dependentRestartFailed: `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`: the replacement took effect but restarting dependents failed.
pluginDefinitionInvalid: `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`: the definition uses retired or unsupported fields.
pluginInstallFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`: install failed; the original error is on `cause`.
setupRequiresAsyncInstall: `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`: `useSync()` met a plugin with `setup`; use `use()`.
pluginDisposeFailed: `PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`: `beforeRelease` or a cleanup step failed; cleanup continued.
extensionDuplicate: `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`: an extension key clashes with an existing member.
extensionObjectPrototype: `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`: an extension key clashes with `Object.prototype` (e.g. `toString`).
extensionReserved: EXTENSION_RESERVED: a key belongs to the canonical Host protocol, including config/use/dispose, then or disposal symbols. This check precedes duplicate detection; other occupied extension keys use EXTENSION_DUPLICATE. Install failures retain the validation error on cause.
prerequisiteDisabled: `PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`: a required provider is disabled; enable it and retry.
prerequisiteRemoved: `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`: a required provider was removed; install it again.
resourceOutsideInstall: `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`: a resource or stage was registered outside the allowed hook.
lifecycleMutation: `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`: a hook (or a waiting setup/beforeRelease) tried to change the host.
invalidPipelineMode: `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`: the constructor got an invalid pipeline mode.
pipelineModeMismatch: `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`: a stage cannot be lifted to the host mode.
asyncStageInSyncEntry: `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`: a visible async stage prevents synchronous execution before effects.
pipelineNextDuplicate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`: `next()` was called twice in one stage.
pipelineNextLate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE` (diagnostic): `next()` was called after the stage returned and was ignored.
pipelineExecuting: `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`: a stage was registered while a pipeline was running.
pipelineFailed: `PIPELINE_FAILED`: in async mode a stage and its downstream both failed.
pluginInstallRollbackFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED` (diagnostic): rolling back a failed install also failed.
extensionNonEnumerableIgnored: `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED` (diagnostic): non-enumerable install keys were ignored.
mutationQueueTimeout: `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`: a change waited longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` and was dropped.
disposeStepTimeout: `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`: one cleanup step exceeded `disposeStepTimeoutMs`; cleanup continued.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION` (on `TypeError`): an argument or option has an invalid shape.
invalidConfigValue: `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`: configuration contains unsupported values (symbols, class instances).
configCycleRejected: `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`: configuration contains a reference cycle.
mutationExecutionTimeout: `MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`: a running hook exceeded `mutationTimeoutMs`; the change was rolled back.
registrationRevoked: `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`: an extracted extension function belongs to a removed or replaced registration.
installResultThenable: `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`: the `install` result has a `then` key and would be mistaken for a Promise.
pipelineDrainTimeout: PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT: pipelines did not drain in budget. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup, reports through diagnostic, and returns ok:false with the error in errors; it does not acquire the Host disposal physicalCompletion protocol.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: an unclassified configuration recipe/update, functional disposal middleware, or domain-surface option/descriptor read failed. Writable native errors keep identity and stack; immutable or non-Error values remain on cause, and complete foreign identities are preserved.
cleanupIncomplete: `CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`: disposal committed but cleanup failed or is still running.
compositionTargetUnmanaged: `COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`: `openComposition()` got a value that is not a managed host.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.name: hostDisposed
members.description: Thrown when a mutation or registration targets a host after disposal completes. * * The terminal state is irreversible. Create a new host instead of reviving this one. Enforces * the terminal boundary of the two-phase lifecycle contract.

members.name: hostDisposing
members.description: Thrown when a mutation targets a closing host after `dispose()` starts but before the terminal * state. * * This differs from `HOST_DISPOSED` so diagnostics distinguish disposal in progress from * completed disposal. Retrying later cannot reopen either host.

members.name: pluginDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when installing a plugin whose `name` is already occupied. * * Plugin names are unique host keys. Rename the plugin or `unUse()` the previous plugin first.

members.name: pluginNotInstalled
members.description: Thrown when `unUse()` or another operation targets an uninstalled plugin name. * * Check for repeated removal or a misspelled name. Host state stays unchanged. Prepared removals * also reject this code when their exact generation is no longer current; no cleanup may repeat * and a replacement registration stays live.

members.name: pluginDisabled
members.description: A handle member, or an extension taken from it, is used while that plugin is disabled; also * thrown by `activate()` on a disabled lazy plugin. Enforces per-registration liveness; the * caller should `enable` the plugin (or its restore token) before retrying.

members.name: pluginSuspended
members.description: A dependent plugin is temporarily suspended because one of its required providers is inactive. * The caller must restore or reinstall the provider and wait for automatic resume before * retrying. Enforces the suspend dependency policy without treating the registration as removed.

members.name: pluginNotActivated
members.description: A lazy plugin is accessed synchronously before activation, or a synchronous install needs an * inactive lazy provider. Activation is an explicit async step; the caller should `await * host.activate(name)` or install through the async `use()` path.

members.name: featureNotDeclared
members.description: `definition.getFeature(name)` or `handle.getFeature(name)` named a Feature the plugin does not * declare. Lookups never return `undefined`; the caller has a wrong name or wrong plugin.

members.name: prerequisiteMissing
members.description: A required Feature provider was never installed in this host (a removed one reports * `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`). Thrown before any install hook runs; install the provider first or in * the same batch.

members.name: dependencyCycle
members.description: Cross-plugin Feature references inside one batch form a cycle. Detected before any install hook * runs; the caller must break the cycle in its plugin definitions.

members.name: dependencyBlocked
members.description: `unUse`/`disable` (or a managed removal) would leave required dependents behind and cascade was * not requested. State is unchanged; `detail.blockedBy` lists every transitive dependent in * cascade order — pass `policy: 'cascade'`, include them, or inspect `dryRun` first.

members.name: replaceNameMismatch
members.description: `replace(name, next)` received a candidate whose name differs from `name`. Nothing is * installed; the caller passed the wrong definition.

members.name: dependentRestartFailed
members.description: `replace()` published the new provider, but at least one dependent that had to restart (no * `onDependencyReplaced`, or the hook threw) failed to reinstall. The replacement stays * committed, the previous provider is disposed, and the failed restart closure stays uninstalled. * `cause` is an `AggregateError` whose first entry is the restart failure, followed by the hook * and cleanup errors; the caller should reinstall the listed dependents after fixing them.

members.name: pluginDefinitionInvalid
members.description: A plugin definition carries a retired or unsupported field (for example `shared`), or its * dependency data is structurally invalid, or runtime integration is requested from an object * that is not a canonical package-minted core. Definition admission and the runtime integration * port reject these inputs; migrate to Feature dependencies or use the original install core.

members.name: pluginInstallFailed
members.description: Thrown when plugin installation or publication fails. Native shared-publication TypeErrors * retain their runtime type with this code. The original installation error always remains * primary and is reachable by identity through `cause`, as required by the error-code contract. * * `detail` retains the failed plugin name and original rollback failures in rollback order. Async * `use()` publishes the completed frozen detail directly. Sync `useSync()` publishes a frozen * snapshot and exposes the final frozen detail through `detail.completion`. Rollback or cleanup * failures use the diagnostic code `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`. They never replace the * original construction failure. Await completion before converting errors that require complete * secondary failure identities.

members.name: setupRequiresAsyncInstall
members.description: A plugin selected for immediate `useSync()` installation declares async setup. * * Callers must install it through `use()` so setup settles before features and install run.

members.name: pluginDisposeFailed
members.description: Thrown when a cleanup step fails during one plugin's `unUse()` or `beforeRelease()`. * * Failures are aggregated after unloading finishes. One disposer failure does not stop remaining * releases. Treat this as a resource-leak warning, not a signal that host state rolls back.

members.name: extensionDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when an extension returned by `install()` conflicts with an existing host property. A * shared slot accepts only canonical contributions from registrations in the same family. * Ordinary extensions and other families cannot occupy the same key. * * Ordinary extension properties remain exclusive. Rename the property or use a canonical * same-family contribution. Conflict detection happens before mounting, so no partially mounted * state is published.

members.name: extensionObjectPrototype
members.description: Thrown when an extension name conflicts with an `Object.prototype` key such as `toString` or * `constructor`. * * Rejecting it before mounting preserves prototype lookup and prevents a prototype-pollution * entry point.

members.name: extensionReserved
members.description: Thrown when an extension uses a reserved host key such as `config`, `onDispose`, or * `usePipeline`. * * Reserved keys belong to the host protocol. Overwriting them would let plugins disrupt each * other. Choose another extension name.

members.name: prerequisiteDisabled
members.description: A Feature prerequisite exists but its owner is temporarily disabled. The caller may enable that * owner and retry the same lookup.

members.name: prerequisiteRemoved
members.description: A previously published Feature prerequisite lost its owner through removal. The caller must * install a provider again; retrying the unchanged lookup cannot recover it.

members.name: resourceOutsideInstall
members.description: Thrown when a plugin context registers an `onDispose()` resource outside installation or after * setup ends. Resources belong to the current attempt. A late setup-context registration releases * its resource before rejecting; core.onDispose() outside install rejects without acquiring that * input. Register through the context that owns the active setup or installation phase.

members.name: lifecycleMutation
members.description: Thrown when a plugin lifecycle callback (`setup`, `install`, `dispose`, `update`, or * `beforeRelease`) reenters a host mutation API, or an external `config.update()` runs during * setup or `beforeRelease`. A synchronous `activate()` reentry rejects before sharing an existing * activation. After an await, same-name activation callers share that Promise regardless of * origin; callers must avoid awaiting their own activation. * * Reentrancy makes installation rollback boundaries ambiguous. Move later mutations outside * lifecycle callbacks.

members.name: invalidPipelineMode
members.description: Thrown during host construction for a pipeline mode outside `sync`, `async`, `generator`, or * `async-generator`. * * Configuration validation rejects the input before the host is constructed.

members.name: pipelineModeMismatch
members.description: Thrown when a registered stage is incompatible with the host's pipeline mode. * * For example, a sync host cannot accept a generator stage. Supported lifting follows the * canonical middleware runner; other combinations fail with both host and stage modes in the * message. Explicit sync/async entries also reject generator hosts; use runPipeline for their * existing generator protocol. Select a compatible runner rather than bypassing stages.

members.name: asyncStageInSyncEntry
members.description: The synchronous entry sees an installed asynchronous stage. No stage or terminal runs; use * runPipelineAsync or remove/disable that stage before retrying synchronously.

members.name: pipelineNextDuplicate
members.description: Thrown when `next()` is called twice within one pipeline step. * * A step can advance only once. Repeated calls would process the same value downstream more than * once. Check stage branches for a missing `return`.

members.name: pipelineNextLate
members.description: Reports a `next()` call after the stage returns or completes. * * The value can no longer enter the pipeline safely, so the call is ignored. An async branch that * is not awaited is a common cause.

members.name: pipelineExecuting
members.description: Thrown when a stage is registered while the pipeline is executing. * * Changing stages during execution would make behavior depend on registration timing. Complete * stage registration before execution starts.

members.name: pipelineFailed
members.description: Thrown when an async stage and its downstream both fail. An `AggregateError` retains `errors` * in the fixed order `[stageError, downstreamError]`. * * Both original errors remain reachable by identity in `errors`. Handle each failure rather than * retrying it as one stage failure.

members.name: pluginInstallRollbackFailed
members.description: Diagnostic code that is reported, never thrown. * * Reports through `diagnostic` when `install()` fails and rollback also fails. The primary error * retains `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` and `cause` equal to the original installation error. This * additional signal never rewrites or replaces the primary error. Some installed plugins may * remain incompletely unloaded, leaving inconsistent host state. Treat the failure as * unrecoverable and rebuild the host.

members.name: extensionNonEnumerableIgnored
members.description: Diagnostic code that is reported, never thrown. * * Reports a non-enumerable property intentionally skipped when mounting an `install()` result. * Ignoring such keys is part of the contract, but reporting explains why they are absent from the * host. Make the property enumerable to expose it.

members.name: mutationQueueTimeout
members.description: Thrown when a mutation exceeds its configured FIFO admission wait and is removed and rejected. * * The caller configures this admission limit. Without a limit, the host reports waits without * rejecting them. This code wraps lifecycle `QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT` at the plugin-host * boundary. `cause` retains the original lifecycle error. * * The mutation is terminated and never executes. This differs from `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`, which * stops waiting and continues disposal.

members.name: disposeStepTimeout
members.description: Reported when one disposer exceeds its wait limit without settling. This includes pipeline * disposers, plugin `dispose` or `beforeRelease` hooks, and resource disposers. * * A disposer that awaits the `host.dispose()` call responsible for running it cannot settle on * its own. * * Disposal continues after recording the step as failed and ending the wait. The running disposer * is not cancelled because JavaScript cannot safely revoke an active Promise chain. The * transaction can still reach disposed state. This differs from `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`, which * terminates the queued mutation.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Thrown as a native `TypeError` with an attached code when input violates its contract. Inputs * include plugin names, configuration paths, stages, extensions, domain cores, and resource * disposers. * * Correct the input before retrying. This is a programming error, not a runtime state failure.

members.name: invalidConfigValue
members.description: Config value violates the admitted plain-data grammar; caller must supply an allowed value.

members.name: callbackFailed
members.description: A public configuration recipe/update, domain-surface descriptor read, or factory disposal * callback failed without a semantic identity. Native mutable errors keep their instance, type, * and stack; immutable/non-Error values stay on cause. Existing upstream source/code stays owned * there. Inspect the callback failure; a rejected configuration patch was not committed and a * disposal completion remains terminal.

members.name: configCycleRejected
members.description: Config input contains a reference cycle; caller must supply an acyclic value graph.

members.name: mutationExecutionTimeout
members.description: A lifecycle hook exceeded the admitted mutation budget and lost commit authority.

members.name: registrationRevoked
members.description: A previously published view was logically revoked by removal or disposal.

members.name: installResultThenable
members.description: Plugin install returned an own `then` key, which is never a publishable extension result.

members.name: pipelineDrainTimeout
members.description: Active pipeline work exceeded the admitted drain budget; ordinary unUse reports it and returns * ok:false while bounded cleanup continues.

members.name: cleanupIncomplete
members.description: Logical disposal completed while one or more physical cleanup tasks remain unsettled.

members.name: compositionTargetUnmanaged
members.description: `openComposition` was given a target this package never registered as a managed host. * * The managed protocol is reached through the composition entry rather than off the host * instance, so the only admissible targets are the ones the host registers at construction. A * caller that gets this has an object that is not a host of this package — a plain object, a host * from a different copy of the package, or a value that was never constructed at all.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The 45 Host error and diagnostic codes. Host protocol and configuration-domain failures use PluginHostError; input/definition validation preserves native TypeError. CALLBACK_FAILED classifies otherwise unowned callback or surface-descriptor failures while preserving writable native identity, immutable/non-Error cause and existing foreign ownership. Diagnostic-only codes reach diagnostic instead of being thrown.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import PluginHostErrorCode from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use PluginHostErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when PluginHostErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
hostDisposed: `HOST_DISPOSED`: the host finished disposal; create a new host.
hostDisposing: `HOST_DISPOSING`: disposal started; no new change can start.
pluginDuplicate: `PLUGIN_DUPLICATE`: the plugin is installed, or a batch repeats a name.
pluginNotInstalled: `PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED`: no plugin of that name (`unUse`, `config.update`, handle access).
pluginDisabled: `PLUGIN_DISABLED`: the plugin is disabled; enable it first.
pluginSuspended: `PLUGIN_SUSPENDED`: suspended because a required provider is unavailable.
pluginNotActivated: `PLUGIN_NOT_ACTIVATED`: a lazy plugin was used before `activate()`.
featureNotDeclared: `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`: `getFeature(name)` asked for an undeclared Feature.
prerequisiteMissing: `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`: a required provider was never installed.
dependencyCycle: `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`: Feature references form a cycle; nothing was installed.
dependencyBlocked: `DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`: required dependents block removal or disabling; see `detail.blockedBy`.
replaceNameMismatch: `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`: `replace(name, next)` got a different plugin name.
dependentRestartFailed: `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED`: the replacement took effect but restarting dependents failed.
pluginDefinitionInvalid: `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`: the definition uses retired or unsupported fields.
pluginInstallFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED`: install failed; the original error is on `cause`.
setupRequiresAsyncInstall: `SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL`: `useSync()` met a plugin with `setup`; use `use()`.
pluginDisposeFailed: `PLUGIN_DISPOSE_FAILED`: `beforeRelease` or a cleanup step failed; cleanup continued.
extensionDuplicate: `EXTENSION_DUPLICATE`: an extension key clashes with an existing member.
extensionObjectPrototype: `EXTENSION_OBJECT_PROTOTYPE`: an extension key clashes with `Object.prototype` (e.g. `toString`).
extensionReserved: EXTENSION_RESERVED: a key belongs to the canonical Host protocol, including config/use/dispose, then or disposal symbols. This check precedes duplicate detection; other occupied extension keys use EXTENSION_DUPLICATE. Install failures retain the validation error on cause.
prerequisiteDisabled: `PREREQUISITE_DISABLED`: a required provider is disabled; enable it and retry.
prerequisiteRemoved: `PREREQUISITE_REMOVED`: a required provider was removed; install it again.
resourceOutsideInstall: `RESOURCE_OUTSIDE_INSTALL`: a resource or stage was registered outside the allowed hook.
lifecycleMutation: `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`: a hook (or a waiting setup/beforeRelease) tried to change the host.
invalidPipelineMode: `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`: the constructor got an invalid pipeline mode.
pipelineModeMismatch: `PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH`: a stage cannot be lifted to the host mode.
asyncStageInSyncEntry: `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`: a visible async stage prevents synchronous execution before effects.
pipelineNextDuplicate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE`: `next()` was called twice in one stage.
pipelineNextLate: `PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE` (diagnostic): `next()` was called after the stage returned and was ignored.
pipelineExecuting: `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`: a stage was registered while a pipeline was running.
pipelineFailed: `PIPELINE_FAILED`: in async mode a stage and its downstream both failed.
pluginInstallRollbackFailed: `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED` (diagnostic): rolling back a failed install also failed.
extensionNonEnumerableIgnored: `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED` (diagnostic): non-enumerable install keys were ignored.
mutationQueueTimeout: `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`: a change waited longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` and was dropped.
disposeStepTimeout: `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT`: one cleanup step exceeded `disposeStepTimeoutMs`; cleanup continued.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION` (on `TypeError`): an argument or option has an invalid shape.
invalidConfigValue: `INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE`: configuration contains unsupported values (symbols, class instances).
configCycleRejected: `CONFIG_CYCLE_REJECTED`: configuration contains a reference cycle.
mutationExecutionTimeout: `MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT`: a running hook exceeded `mutationTimeoutMs`; the change was rolled back.
registrationRevoked: `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`: an extracted extension function belongs to a removed or replaced registration.
installResultThenable: `INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE`: the `install` result has a `then` key and would be mistaken for a Promise.
pipelineDrainTimeout: PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT: pipelines did not drain in budget. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup, reports through diagnostic, and returns ok:false with the error in errors; it does not acquire the Host disposal physicalCompletion protocol.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: an unclassified configuration recipe/update, functional disposal middleware, or domain-surface option/descriptor read failed. Writable native errors keep identity and stack; immutable or non-Error values remain on cause, and complete foreign identities are preserved.
cleanupIncomplete: `CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE`: disposal committed but cleanup failed or is still running.
compositionTargetUnmanaged: `COMPOSITION_TARGET_UNMANAGED`: `openComposition()` got a value that is not a managed host.

blocks.text: PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `@migaia/plugin-host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

rows: 宿主已终态，创建新 Host，不能复用。
宿主正在关闭，不能开始新变更。
同一名称已占用或在批次中重复。
目标名称不存在，或句柄已无对应安装。
插件禁用中，先恢复再调用。
必需 provider 不可用使插件挂起，先恢复依赖。
lazy 插件未激活，先 await activate。
请求了未声明的 Feature 名称。
必需 provider 从未安装，安装前直接拒绝。
必需 provider 已禁用，启用后重试。
必需 provider 已卸载，需要重新安装。
Feature 跨插件引用成环，任何 install 前拒绝。
变更会遗留必需依赖者，detail.blockedBy 列出传递闭包。
替换候选名称不同，未安装候选。
新 provider 已提交但依赖者重装失败，cause.errors 首项为重装失败。
退役或不支持的定义字段、非法依赖或非 canonical core，保留 TypeError。
安装/发布失败，原错在 cause，回滚详情保留次错。
即时 useSync 安装遇到 setup，改用异步 use。
仅诊断：回滚也失败，不替换原安装主错。
install 结果自带 then，或同步路径得到异步结果，不发布此扩展。
beforeRelease 或插件释放步骤失败，cause 保留原错，其余清理继续。
扩展键已占用，Host 保留键优先分类为 EXTENSION_RESERVED。
扩展使用 Host 协议键、then 或清理 symbol。
仅诊断：有意忽略非枚举扩展键。
core 在安装窗口外拒绝且不接管；setup 关闭后的有效资源先释放再拒绝。
生命周期同步重入，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期发起变更，不能执行。
构造时 mode 非四种合法值。
stage 无法提升到 Host 模式，cause 保留上游 TypeError。
同次 stage 重复调用 next，不重复派发。
仅诊断：stage 已结束后调用 next，忽略此调用。
管线执行期间注册新 stage。
async 双失败，AggregateError.errors 固定为 stage、downstream。
已配置准入期限且排队到限，任务移出并不再执行。
beforeRelease 或普通释放步骤超预算，结束等待并继续清理，不强行取消。
入参形状不合法，保留原生 TypeError，修正输入。
配置不满足普通数据语法，detail 含 path/reason。
配置含引用环，提供无环值图。
未分类配置、surface 读取或 defineHost disposal 回调失败；保留原错或 cause。
hook 执行到限，丧失提交权限，迟到结果不能提交。
已取出的扩展属于已卸载或替换的旧注册。
普通卸载排空超预算，ok false，继续有界清理并诊断。
逻辑关闭已提交，清理有错或仍未完成；读取结果与 continuation。
组合目标非本物理包登记的 Host，不做结构兼容。

hook 执行到限，丧失提交权限，迟到结果不能提交。
已取出的扩展属于已卸载或替换的旧注册。
普通卸载排空超预算，ok false，继续有界清理并诊断。
逻辑关闭已提交，清理有错或仍未完成；读取结果与 continuation。
组合目标非本物理包登记的 Host，不做结构兼容。
